source: Occupancy is therefore a residency ratio, not the percentage of arithmetic units doing useful work. Nsight Compute even provides a dedicated Occupancy Calculator because the interaction of resource limits and allocation granularity can be non-obvious.[3]
zh: 因此，占用率是居住率，而不是做有用工作的算术单元的百分比。 Nsight Compute 甚至提供了专用的占用计算器，因为资源限制和分配粒度的相互作用可能并不明显。 [3]
